culture.en: Travel helps us understand different cultures.
culture.cn: 旅行帮助我们理解不同文化。

language.en: She can speak four languages fluently.

country.en: Every country has its own unique customs.
country.cn: 每个国家都有独特习俗。

food.en: I love trying different food from around the world.
food.cn: 我喜欢尝试世界各地的食物。

chopsticks.en: Learning to use chopsticks takes a little practice.

respect.en: We should respect cultures that are different from ours.
respect.cn: 我们应当尊重与我们不同的文化。

amazing.en: The view from the mountain top is truly amazing.
amazing.cn: 山顶的风景真的令人惊叹。

learn.en: We can learn so much by listening to people from other places.
learn.cn: 倾听来自其他地方的人，我们能学到很多。
